response.description:
Auto scaling introduces a
per-workspace capability in Azure Monitor Workspace (AMW) to automatically
scale ingestion limits based on observed usage patterns. When enabled, the
system dynamically adjusts ingestion limits (quota ceiling) to maintain healthy
utilization and reduce the need for manual limit management. Limits are increased as your metrics volume
grows and can be decreased when usage stays low for a sustained period of time.Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Auto scaling of ingestion limits in Azure Monitor workspace
